title: The World’s Oldest Shipwreck? Maybe, but ‘We’re All Excited by Maybe.’
summary_full: Archaeologists said that they had found jars from a shipwreck as much as 4,700 years old, with black residue inside. Outside experts were skeptical but intrigued.
